verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a dedicated sandbox MCP endpoint (mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz) distinct from production, implying a test environment for agent commerce workflows without touching live payment flows. However, there is no further documentation on sandbox wallets, test tokens, isolation guarantees, or how to obtain sandbox credentials. Missing for 10: detailed sandbox setup/test-token docs, confirmation that sandbox funds/settlement are isolated from production wallets, independent/hands-on verification.
